description: This file defines the main route component for a notes management web application built with Qwik. It imports and composes core components like Header, Sidebar, NotesList, and NoteEditor, and sets up a data refresh on mount via useNotesProvider and useVisibleTask$.

methods.name: component$
methods.description: Creates a Qwik component that renders the main notes application layout and sets up initial data loading.

methods.name: useVisibleTask$
methods.description: Sets up a task to run when the component becomes visible, used here to trigger refresh of notes data.
